# rixl_policy_attachments (Data Source)

Lists policy attachments linking IAM policies to entities and resources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "rixl_policy_attachments" "role_bindings" {
  org_id    = var.rixl_org_id
  policy_id = var.rixl_policy_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `org_id` (String)
- `policy_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `attachments` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--attachments))

- `id` (String)
